Paul Logistics is hiring a Full-Stack Developer to design, develop, and maintain internal applications and tools supporting its logistics and brokerage operations. The role builds web applications, dashboards, automation, and integrations in collaboration with IT leadership and operational teams.

Responsibilities
Develop and maintain internal web applications used by operations and leadership
Build both front-end interfaces and back-end services for internal tools
Assist in designing and implementing automation for business processes
Work with databases to store, retrieve, and analyze operational data
Integrate internal systems with APIs and third-party services
Troubleshoot, debug, and improve existing applications and internal tools
Collaborate with IT leadership and operational teams to translate business needs into software solutions

Basic understanding of cloud platforms or server environments
